errors.evidence: The vertical axis does not have a label. The phrase 'Общ добив в тона' is part of the legend entries, not a label for the y-axis.
The highest bar (potatoes in 2022) is clearly below the 180,000 mark on the y-axis, closer to 173,000. Describing it as 'около 180 000' is an inaccurate overestimation.
